_meanings:
.²1 A seal, an instrument for sealing or stamping; especially a seal-ring,
 signet-ring; {#anayA mudrayA mudrayEnam#} <ls>Mu. 1</ls>; {#nAmamudrAkzarARyanuvAcya#}
 {#parasparamavalokayataH#} <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; {#baBO marutvAn vikftaH sa-mudraH#} <ls>Bk. 10. 19</ls>
 (<ab>fig.</ab> also); {#iti prAyo BAvAH sPuradavaDimudrAmukulitAH#} <ls>Bh. 2. 114</ls>.
.²2 A stamp, print, mark, impression; {#catuHsamudramudraH#} <ls>K. 191</ls>; {#sindUramudrANkitaH#}
 ({#bAhuH#}) <ls>Gīt. 4</ls>.
.²3 A pass, passport (as given by a seal-ring); {#agfhItamudraH kawakAnnizkrAmasi#}
 <ls>Mu. 5</ls>; {#gfhItamudraH saleKaH puruzo gfhItaH#} <ls>Mu. 5</ls>; {#SAhasUnoH SivasyEzA#}
 {#mudrA BadrAya rAjate#} (wording on Śivājeeʼs seal).
.²4 A stamped coin, coin, piece of money.
.²5 A medal.
.²6 An image, a sign, badge, token.
.²7 Shutting, closing, sealing; {#sEvOzWamudrA sa ca karRapASaH#} <ls>U. 6. 27</ls>;
 {#kzipannidrAmudrAM madanakalahacCedasulaBAm#} <ls>Māl. 2. 12</ls> ‘removing
 the seal of sleep’ <ab>&c.</ab>
.²8 A mystery.
.²9 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) The expression of things by their right names.
.²10 <ab>N.</ab> of certain positions of the fingers practised in devotion or religious
 worship; {#yojanAt sarvadevAnAM drAvaRAt pApasaMhateH . tasmAnmudreti#}
 {#sA KyAtA sarvakAmArTasADanI#} <ls>Tantrasāra</ls>; <ls>Dk. 2. 2</ls>.
.²11 A particular branch of education (reckoning by the fingers).
.²12 A dance accordant with tradition.
.²13 A lock, stopper.
.²14 A nymph; {#baBO marutvAn vikftaH samudraH#} <ls>Bk. 10. 19</ls>.
.²15 “Parched grain” in the form of rice, paddy <ab>etc.</ab> (<ls>Yoginī Tantra, Ch. VI quoted in Woodroffe, Śakti and Śākta, 571).</ls>
.²16 Particular lines, marks; {#mAtA putraH pitA BrAtA BAryA mitrajanastaTA .#}
 {#azwApadapadasTAne dakza mudreva lakzyate ..#} <ls>Mb. 12. 298. 40</ls>.
.²17 Type or block for printing.

.²1 a letter of the seal.
.²2 a type (a modern use).
stamped with a seal, sealed, stamped.

the keeper of the seal; the officer in charge of the fort;
 {#tato mudrADipo muKyaH kOkzeyakasahAyavAn#} <ls>Parṇāl. 3. 37</ls>.

an opening believed to exist in the crown of the head
 through which the soul is said to escape at death; <ab>cf.</ab> {#brahmaranDra#}.
a press, a printing-press (a modern formation).

an alphabet of written characters; {#mudrAlipiH SilpalipirlipirleKanisaMBavA .#}
 {#guRqikA GuRasaMBUtA lipayaH paYcaDA matAH ..#}
the place (on the finger) for a seal-ring; <ls>Ś.</ls>
